annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3265-17 Standard Test Method for Grid-Video Obstacle Measurement
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3265-17 Standard Test Method for Grid-Video Obstacle Measurement
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.13
annotation.summary_en: ASTM F3265-17 is a voluntary test method that measures how an automatic/autonomous unmanned ground vehicle (A-UGV) reduces kinetic energy and stops when obstacles enter its path within the safety sensors' stop-detect range. It supplements, but does not replace, ANSI/ITSDF B56.5 safety testing. The page excerpt also contains ordering and shipping information.
key_provisions_or_claims: Measures A-UGV kinetic energy reduction and stopping distance when an obstacle appears in the vehicle path.
Uses a test piece from ANSI/ITSDF B56.5 and can use other test pieces from it.
Intended for A-UGV manufacturers, installers and users.
Does not substitute for safety testing required by ANSI/ITSDF B56.5 or other normative standards.
Tests are performed in a laboratory, with environmental conditions recorded per ASTM F3218.
